title: Item Model Command
description: Set custom models using the new model system through a simple command
body:
Use the command format /item model "namespace:item_name"

You will be able to find the namespace of the pack inside the resource pack folder, along with the item name.

This does NOT use custom model data.


Example:
/item model grouphardcore:penguin_sword

![Example file structure associated with the example command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ee3628d58a359608087e0cd0abecf8f81da125e_0.webp)
